releases.title: cut-v4: sound-only fix (crickets, rumble)
releases.author: editor
releases.body: Sound-only change vs cut-v3; picture stream is bit-identical (frame md5 equal). Crickets rebuilt as real chirp structure: 5 individuals, groups of 3-5 resonant ~12 ms pulses at ~40 Hz, 1.3-2.6 chirps/s, jitter in timing/pitch/level. River: low rumble band moved up (200-500 Hz, halved) and a layer of short upward-gliding 'bloop' water texture added. AST proxy (director's tools/tag_stems.py, tag_audio.py): crickets stem Insect 0.20 / Cricket 0.18 / Frog 0.14, Ringtone gone from the top tags (was Ringtone 0.25); water+wind stem Waves 0.17 / Rain 0.16 / Ocean 0.15; end card 17.5-20 Explosion 0.06 (was 0.37). Cricket band 4-5 kHz is +12.7 dB over river at 1-6 s. Measured: 20.000 s, 1280x720 24 fps, AAC stereo 48k, -16.1 LUFS, sample peak -4.5 dBFS.

releases.title: cut-v3: QC fixes 1-3
releases.author: editor
releases.body: Changes vs cut-v2: (1) S2->S3 is a straight cut at 9.5 s (no superimposed lanterns); (2) S4 holds to 17.4 and dissolves (0.5 s) into the star plate with the lantern's warm point visible until the dissolve; 'The End' fades in during the dissolve, fully up by ~17.8 s, bright to 19.3 s, picture+text fade to black 19.3-20.0; (3) crickets +11 dB over the river in their band (measured 4-5 kHz, 1-6 s: 11.0 dB above river; was ~2 dB), river hiss trimmed, crickets fade gently out by the stars; music +3.5 dB over S4 (13.5-17 s). Measured: 20.000 s, 1280x720 24 fps H.264, AAC stereo 48k, -16.1 LUFS, sample peak -3.9 dBFS; black only 0-0.17 s and 19.67-19.96 s.
